name: checkbox
title: Checkbox
purpose: A native checkbox with its label: one yes-or-no choice, or several independent choices in a group, sent with a form.
whenToUse: For a choice the reader confirms with the rest of a form, such as Open the pull request as a draft.
For several options where any number may be chosen, in a fieldset with a legend.
For a select-all box over a list, which is indeterminate while only some rows are selected.
whenNotToUse: For a setting that takes effect the moment it changes. Use a switch.
To choose exactly one of several options. Use a radio group, or a segmented control for two to five short options.
To choose one of many options. Use a select.

variants.name: single
variants.use: The default: a div with ds-checkbox holding the input, the label, and optionally a description and an error.

variants.name: group
variants.use: A fieldset holding a ds-checkbox__legend and one ds-checkbox per option, one above the other.

accessibility: Use input type="checkbox" with ds-checkbox__input, followed by a label with ds-checkbox__label whose for attribute is the input's id. The input comes first in the markup: the stylesheet reads its state to style the label after it.
A description is a p with ds-checkbox__description, linked from the input with aria-describedby.
Group related checkboxes in a fieldset with ds-checkbox__group, and name the group with a legend carrying ds-checkbox__legend.

Indeterminate cannot be written in markup. The app sets the property with script, input.indeterminate = true, and clears it when the box is next changed. A screen reader then announces it as mixed. Do not set aria-checked on a native checkbox.
For an error, set aria-invalid="true" on the input and link a p with ds-checkbox__error through aria-describedby. The message says what to do, and its icon is drawn by the stylesheet.
Set the disabled attribute when the choice is unavailable, and say why in the description. A disabled checkbox leaves the tab order.

Tab reaches each checkbox and Space toggles it. The box is drawn 20px square and its pointer target is as tall and as wide as the row is tall, 36px by default and 44px on a coarse pointer; a press on the label toggles it too.
